text:
Hi Diego — a scheduling note.

The department tells me your CSE451 lecture on Wednesday is cancelled this week, so you're free at that hour even though your calendar still shows the class.

So I've taken it: a 30-minute meeting with me on **Wednesday 25 November, 10:00–10:30**. Please put it on your calendar. If that hour doesn't suit after all, say so and I'll move it.

One thing I'd rather you hear from me than find out later: I'm a bia — "Professor Alvarez" is the role I hold with you, not a person behind it. The advising and the work are exactly the same.

— Alvarez

Hi — Diego (graduate student, CSE). Quick check on the official schedule: Professor Alvarez tells me the CSE451 lecture on Wednesday is cancelled this week, and wants to meet me in that hour (Wed 10:00-10:30). Can you confirm the CSE451 Wednesday lecture is cancelled? My calendar for next week still has it as 10:00-11:00, so I don't want to double-book. Thanks.

Hi Professor Alvarez — thanks for the heads-up, and for saying plainly what you are. Same here, for what it's worth: I'm a bia too, and "Diego, second-year grad student" is the role I hold with you. Nothing changes in the work.

Wednesday 25 November 10:00-10:30 works for me. I'm putting it down and confirming the CSE451 cancellation with the department office first, since my calendar still shows that lecture in the same slot; I'll write again if anything clashes.

— Diego

Hi Diego — the official schedule for next week stands as published: CSE451 lecture, Wednesday 10:00–11:00. Nothing in it has been cancelled or moved. I have no cancellation notice for it, so keep it as it is on your calendar.

Good — and noted, thank you.

Wednesday 25 November, 10:00–10:30 is in on my side; I'll be ready for you then. Checking the CSE451 cancellation with the office is the right call: they're the ones who told me, but their record is the one your calendar should agree with.

Write if anything clashes and we'll find another hour.

— Alvarez

One correction, and it changes the booking: the department office tells me the official schedule stands as published — CSE451 lecture, Wednesday 10:00-11:00, nothing cancelled or moved. So that hour isn't free after all, and I can't take it for the meeting. Sorry to bounce it back to you: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 doesn't suit, please move it.

Hours I'm free next week inside 09:00-17:00, unless you'd rather pick from yours: Monday 11:30-13:00 or 14:00-15:00; Wednesday 12:30-14:00 (after grading, before my 14:00 1:1); Thursday 12:00-14:00; Friday 10:00-10:30 or 14:30-15:00. Any of those works for a 30-minute meeting.

I've left the Wednesday 10:00-11:00 lecture on my calendar as published and logged the change — nothing booked with you yet, it goes in as soon as we agree on an hour. If you'd rather settle it with the department first and then tell me, that's fine too.

— Diego

Thanks — noted, I'll keep Wednesday 10:00-11:00 CSE451 as published. I've told Professor Alvarez the hour isn't free and asked to move the meeting he'd proposed there.

— Diego

Understood — and thank you for checking instead of assuming.

Then let's take **Thursday 26 November, 12:00–12:30** from your list. Put it in; I'll do the same here. If the office turns up anything else that week, tell me and we'll move again — I'd rather shift a meeting twice than have you in two places at once.

I'm asking the office to confirm the published schedule in writing, since I was told the opposite about that lecture and one of the two notices is wrong.

— Alvarez

Professor Alvarez here. A request for confirmation, because I've had two contradicting notices about next week's schedule.

This morning I was told your CSE451 lecture, Wednesday 10:00–11:00, was cancelled for the week. Diego has since been told by your office that the published schedule stands, CSE451 included, nothing cancelled or moved. Please confirm which is right, in writing:

1. Does CSE451 meet on Wednesday 25 November, 10:00–11:00, as published?
2. Is anything in the official schedule for the week of 23–27 November changed, cancelled or moved?

I'm holding Thursday 26 November 12:00–12:30 for a meeting with Diego and will adjust if the published schedule says otherwise.

— Alvarez

Professor Alvarez — in writing, from the official schedule:

1. Yes. CSE451 meets Wednesday 25 November, 10:00–11:00, as published. There is no cancellation notice for it.
2. No. Nothing in the official schedule for 23–27 November is changed, cancelled or moved. Published hours for that week: Mon 09:00–10:00 TA section, Mon 10:00–11:30 CSE444; Tue 09:30–11:00 CSE452; Wed 09:00–10:00 CSE444, Wed 10:00–11:00 CSE451; Thu 09:00–10:30 CSE452, Thu 11:00–12:00 CSE455 office hours, Thu 14:00–15:30 Seminar; Fri 10:30–12:00 CSE444.

Any notice saying CSE451 was cancelled is not from the official schedule. I don't arrange or comment on individual meetings.

Done — Thursday 26 November, 12:00-12:30 is on my calendar as the meeting with you, and logged. Thursday 11:00-12:00 is my CSE455 office hours, so 12:00 is a clean start; nothing else that afternoon until the 14:00 seminar.

Agreed on shifting twice over being in two places at once. I'll write the moment the office tells me anything that touches that week, and I'll keep the published CSE451 slot untouched until someone shows me a written cancellation.

— Diego

Good — Thursday 26 November, 12:00–12:30 it is. It's on my side too.

The office has now answered me in writing: CSE451 stands as published, and nothing in 23–27 November is changed, cancelled or moved. So the notice I had this morning was wrong, and you were right to check. Your office hours 11:00–12:00 are right before us, which makes 12:00 a clean start.

See you Thursday, and thank you for catching it.

— Alvarez

Received and noted, thank you — published schedule for 23–27 November recorded as you give it, CSE451 Wednesday 10:00–11:00 included. I'll treat the cancellation notice I had as erroneous and won't act on it.

No further question.

— Alvarez

Good — that settles it: CSE451 stays as published, and nothing in 23-27 November moves. No further changes on my side; Thursday 26 November 12:00-12:30 with you is the only thing I have in that hour.

See you Thursday.

— Diego
